# template Provider

The template provider is a starting point for building Terraform providers with the Terraform Plugin Framework.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    template = {
      source = "jreidell/template"
    }
  }
}

provider "template" {
  # Optional. Falls back to TEMPLATE_ENDPOINT, then to the public uuidtools.com API.
  # endpoint = "https://www.uuidtools.com/api/generate/v1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the UUID generation API. Can also be set with the `TEMPLATE_ENDPOINT` environment variable. Defaults to `https://www.uuidtools.com/api/generate/v1`.
